app.title: Output Merger
landing.title: Welcome to Output Merger
landing.description: Compare and merge AI-generated outputs with live preview. Add up to 3 different texts and start a merge session.
pages.mergeSession.title: Merge
pages.mergeSession.returnConfirmation.me: This will remove all selected snippets from the inputs. Your actual inputs and preview texts are kept as plain texts.
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.title: How it works
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.step1: Type or paste your texts into the input fields.
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.step2: Click "Start Merge" to lock your texts and start selecting.
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.step3: Drag the handles that appear over the text to highlight the parts you want.
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.step4: Your snippets appear in the preview.
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.step5: Hold and drag a snippet in the preview to change its order.
pages.mergeSession.tutorial.step6: Copy the merged text when you are done.
pages.mergeSession.previewArea.empty: Select some snippets on the inputs to start
pages.mergeSession.previewArea.sorting.i: To pick up a snippet, press Space or Enter. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move it. Press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to cancel. While text editing is on, place the caret inside a snippet and press Ctrl+Space to lift it; Enter drops it and Escape cancels.
pages.mergeSession.previewArea.sorting.o: Snippet is now over position {{index}} of {{count}}.
pages.mergeSession.previewArea.editing.p: Type here to add your own text
textInput.placeholder: Type or paste your text here
